nameEn: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
publisher: Open-Meteo.com; underlying data: ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis, Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S)
license: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo API data; attribution “Weather data by Open-Meteo.com”); contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information. Free tier: non-commercial use, 10 000 calls/day.
notes: Used for public/data/{bangkok,hatyai}/rain-grid.json and data/staged/rain-hourly-events.json. Model ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (Copernicus Climate Change Service, C3S); 0.25° × 0.25° regular latitude/longitude grid (≈27–28 km), hourly. Period 2024-01-01..2026-10-28 (Last local (Asia/Bangkok) date in [2026-10-21, 2026-11-03] whose 24 hourly precipitation values are all non-null at both city-centre points (models=era5).). Distinct ERA5 cells: Bangkok 11 for 42 lattice points, Hat Yai 2 for 25. Raw requests retrieved 2026-11-03T22:59:33.217Z … 2026-11-03T23:01:43.974Z.

nameEn: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — models=best_match (comparison only; = ECMWF IFS for precipitation on the checked windows)
license: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo API data); attribution “Weather data by Open-Meteo.com”.
notes: NOT used in any published value. Only for the model-identity checks and the city-centre comparison in data/staged/rain-grid-meta.json. best_match precipitation was identical to models=ecmwf_ifs (operational IFS analysis/short-range forecast archive, ~9 km) on all checked windows — not a reanalysis. An earlier draft of the grids used best_match; those raw files remain in data/raw/open-meteo/grid_*_best_match_* and are superseded.

HTTP 200 but precipitation_sum is null for every day of the check window: Open-Meteo does not serve ERA5-Land precipitation (ERA5-Land is forced by ERA5 precipitation). Not used; models=era5 used instead.
